note: The passage establishes the adjective's sense. Its semantic relationship to the verb ערר is uncertain.
summary: Abram uses עֲרִירִי to describe himself while he has no offspring. He expects someone from his household to inherit from him.

senses.definition: Describes a person who has no child of their own.

evidence.note: Abram calls himself עֲרִירִי, then explains that he has been given no offspring and that a member of his household will inherit from him.
